sources.title: Restricted and Non-Restricted Countries (Nationalities)
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Ministry of Interior page publishes the Ministry's restricted-nationality schedule and defines its two categories.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Restricted Countries: Countries that need prior approval.

sources.title: Electronic visa service
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Ministry of Interior service card links to the Ministry e-services portal and confirms immediate electronic issuance, payment, and printing before arrival; the linked nationality list is account-gated and not publicly reproducible.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Obtain the immediate entry visa electronically ... and print the visa before arriving in the Kingdom.

sources.title: Frequently asked questions
sources.officialityEvidence: The Ministry of Interior's live FAQ distinguishes immediately printable eVisa issuance from arrival issuance and states that the latter restricted-nationality cases depend on additional conditions.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Electronic visa ... instead of obtaining it on arrival at the border crossing.
